### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/spec`, touching **1** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/liveness/view.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

⛔ **1** release-owned page(s) name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-5.mdx`  _(via CalendarConfigSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/liveness/view.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- the SDK route bridge reached **59** of **211** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **168** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json efdddc90603d4855ca41168e9e507e87edf4316f` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `bda1f3aa116bf765fc4434e20321744e77404052` — the merge of head `471be6e722d42329d229b032157594798cc632c7` into base `efdddc90603d4855ca41168e9e507e87edf4316f`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin bda1f3aa116bf765fc4434e20321744e77404052 && git checkout bda1f3aa116bf765fc4434e20321744e77404052
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin efdddc90603d4855ca41168e9e507e87edf4316f 471be6e722d42329d229b032157594798cc632c7 && git checkout -B drift-repro efdddc90603d4855ca41168e9e507e87edf4316f && git merge --no-ff 471be6e722d42329d229b032157594798cc632c7

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json efdddc90603d4855ca41168e9e507e87edf4316f
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs efdddc90603d4855ca41168e9e507e87edf4316f` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `471be6e722d42329d229b032157594798cc632c7`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts (`CalendarConfigSchema.initialDate`'s TSDoc and describe; `CALENDAR_INITIAL_DATE_RE` and `calendarInitialDateRefusal` read on `main` for parity, untouched), packages/spec/liveness/view.json (the `calendar` row note), ui/packages/plugin-calendar/src/initialDate.ts (whole: `isCalendarRecordAnchor`, `resolveInitialDateMacro`, `recordAnchorQuery`, `anchorDateFromResult`), ui/packages/plugin-calendar/src/ObjectCalendar.tsx (the `currentDate` initializer, `userNavigatedRef`, the anchor effect, `onNavigate`; `toStoredDateValue` / `isDateOnlyField` read for the bound), ui/packages/plugin-calendar/src/index.tsx (the `calendar` input description), ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx (the `calendarBlock` literal), ui/packages/plugin-list/src/index.tsx (the `calendar` input description), ui/packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx (`generateViewSchema`'s calendar branch), ui/packages/types/src/designer.ts (`UnifiedViewConfig.calendar.initialDate`), the three test files, the regenerated manifest, its record and the three reference pages, .changeset/28102-calendar-opens-on-initial-date.md + ui/packages/core/src/utils/date-macros.ts on `main` (`resolveDateMacros(filter, now)`), the spec half's record 6537839837 on PR #28138 (its should-fix 2, the describe split)

Inputs: card #28102 (body and all six comments: triage 6523386496, the spec half's carry-forward 6537924895, the unblock 6538742793, the seat's claim 6538841986 and its amendment 6538859721 which adds the two producer forwards and the liveness note, the dev report 6539576260), PR #28334 (body, the docs-drift comment, the file list of 18 files, the diff of 910 lines against `main` read whole, the nine commits from merge-base 501c864d), the 65 check-runs on this head (read 2026-10-31T06:02Z: all 65 runs completed, none failed, none cancelled, none in progress; success: Auto Label, Build & E2E UI, Build Core, Build Docs, Build UI Deps, Check Changeset, Check Documentation Links, Check PR Size, Dogfood Regression Gate, Flag docs affected by code changes, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Lint & Repo Gates, Lint UI, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Live E2E UI, PR-body guards (claim · duplicate · Part-of · single-writer path), Plan Test Core shards, Spec property liveness, Test Core, Test Core (all 8), Test UI, Test UI (all 16), Type Check UI, Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · debt ledger, Type Check · source gates, Type Check · workspace, TypeScript Type Check, filter; skipped: 18.x upgrade harness (opt-in), Dogfood Regression Gate (matrix shard/3), Dogfood Verify CLI, Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in), Schedule gate · skip when a green push run covers the commit, Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL), UI Published Artifacts), and the tree at this head and on `main` for the items the Scope line names. The head is mergeable and clean against today's `main` (merge-tree clean); none of the files `main` moved since the merge-base is in this diff.

### ① Derived judgments

- **The renderer reads the key where it seeds its date, once, with the three outcomes the spec names** - right. Absent: `useState` falls back to `new Date()`, as before (CONTROL pinned: today, and no anchor read). A wrapped token: `resolveInitialDateMacro` hands the string to `resolveDateMacros`, the client resolver filter values use, inside the `useState` initializer, so the first visible range the calendar reports is already the seeded one (pinned for `{next_month_start}` and `{3_months_from_now}`); a token the resolver leaves as it found it, or that does not parse as a date, answers `null` and the calendar opens on today rather than throwing. A record anchor: one one-row read through `recordAnchorQuery` (the view's resolved filter AND `is_not_null` on the start field for `first_record`, or "at or after the start of today" for `next_record`, `$orderby` start ascending, `$top: 1`), from the same source the record fetch reads (the object provider's data source, or a `ValueDataSource` over inline rows), behind the same object-schema gate; no source, no qualifying record or a failed read (one warning) leaves today. The period is the active mode's, because `currentDate` is what the month, week and day grids already read. Pinned fourteen ways, including the exact read shape.
- **"Today" and the `next_record` bound follow the spec half's S1** - right. The bound is the start of the viewer's local day, spelled by the start field's declared type through the file's own `toStoredDateValue`: a `date` field as the calendar day (`toDateInputValue`), anything else as the instant of local midnight; pinned on a `date` field and on a `datetime` field. With no declared type (an adapter without `getObjectSchema`) it falls to the instant, which the body names as a bound west of UTC; declared `date` fields, the HotCRM case, are bounded as days.
- **Seed once; the user owns the date after** - right. `userNavigatedRef` is set in `onNavigate` before `setCurrentDate`, and the anchor answer returns without moving the calendar once it is set (pinned: a late answer after navigation is discarded); `anchorSeededRef` is set when an answer or a failure lands, not when the read starts, and the effect's cleanup drops an in-flight answer, so a re-run asks again instead of seeding from a stale read (pinned: a navigation survives a re-render with one read).
- **Both producers forward the key inside the `calendar` block** - right, and necessary: `ListView`'s `calendarBlock` literal and `ObjectView`'s `generateViewSchema` forward the block's five bindings by name, so a stored list view's `initialDate` died there and never reached the renderer. Each now forwards it nested, never flat (the node's schema refuses flat keys), pinned four ways each with a CONTROL. The seat accepted both files in amendment 6538859721.
- **The spec edit is the marker removal the spec half promised, and the accepted set is unchanged** - right. `CALENDAR_INITIAL_DATE_RE` and `calendarInitialDateRefusal` are untouched; the TSDoc's "lands ahead of its reader" paragraphs go and name the reader; the describe loses `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]` and is split by form (the absence rule and the period first, the record anchors as one sentence, the token as another), which is the spec half's should-fix 2 (record 6537839837, carried forward as 6537924895) discharged. No key added or removed, no refusal moved, so `Clause-②: yes` is the declaration the diff owes for touching `packages/spec` and nothing an author writes moves.
- **Liveness and the ui-owned copies** - right. The `calendar` row note moves `initialDate` from PLANNED strength to plain live and cites the renderer read, the pure module and both producer forwards by path and symbol; the `object-calendar` and `list-view` registry `calendar` input descriptions and the designer's `calendar` options list the key (the former also gains the `allDayField` it lacked), and the manifest, its record and the reference pages are regenerated.
- **Check-runs as gate verdicts** - read as above; every run on this head completed and none is red, cancelled or in progress at the read.

### ② Semver level

- **`@object-ui/plugin-calendar`, `@object-ui/plugin-list`, `@object-ui/plugin-view`, `@object-ui/types`, `@objectstack/spec` all patch; `Clause-②: yes`; `Metadata-protocol: none`** - accepted. The renderer gains behaviour only where a key that was declared-but-inert is present; `designer.ts` gains an optional member; the spec entry is a describe and TSDoc change on an existing key with the same pattern and refusal. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **`ListView`'s first calendar window still assumes today** - `initialCalendarWindow` (plugin-list `calendarWindow.ts`) computes the first fetch window from the clock, so a seeded calendar's first reported range differs and the list fetches once more for the seeded window: correct rows, one extra request. Outside the lines the seat approved in `ListView.tsx`; a cost note worth its own small card.
- **The anchor reads the view's authored filter only** - the spec's wording ("the records the view's filter selects"); a toolbar filter or search applied later does not re-seed, by the seed-once rule. Not a defect.
- **An embedded renderer handed `data` with no data source opens on today** - nothing to read an anchor from; both console producers hand a data source down.
- **Serial overlap** - `domain:ui#4` holds #25918's reads in `ListView.tsx`; this PR touches only the `calendarBlock` literal, and the second to land merges `main` (the seat's note).
- **No name approval owed** - the key and its values were ruled with #28021 and PR #28138 (where `initialDate`'s name approval was recorded as owed to the maintainer; this PR adds no name).

### ④ Design judgment

- **Nothing blocking, and no should-fix on the diff.** Tried: a token the client resolver does not know (today, not a throw); a `date` start field with rows dated today (included, since the bound is the calendar day itself); inline rows with an undated row first (skipped by `is_not_null`, pinned); the schema arriving after mount for the object provider (the effect waits on `objectSchemaReady`, so the bound is spelled by the declared type, never guessed); an anchor read that resolves after the component unmounted (the cleanup's `live` flag drops it). Keeping the pure half in `initialDate.ts` and the one source-of-truth read beside the record fetch is the right split, and the resolver reuse keeps one date-macro grammar in the console.

**Verdict reasoning.** The reader does what the spec half declared, in the three outcomes it named, with the day-versus-instant bound the spec half's review asked for, seeded once and then owned by the user; the two producer forwards are what makes a stored view reach it; the spec edit is the promised marker removal with the accepted set unchanged and the carried-forward describe split done. Semver is patch everywhere. What remains is the one extra window fetch in `ListView`, named for its own card.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-1tllxq`
Reviewed-by: `session_01L9qibw58ehQ2gRHP2h2Puz`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Console 的日历视图开始读 `calendar.initialDate`。不写时照旧打开今天；写日期宏（如 `{next_month_start}`）时打开该日期所在的月/周/日；写 `first_record` / `next_record` 时用一次单行查询，打开第一条记录或下一条未来记录所在的时段，查不到就打开今天。之后用户翻页不会被重置。
- 为什么改：#28102（#28021 的消费半，spec 半 PR #28138 已合并）：这个键在 spec 里已声明，但渲染器不读，作者配置了也没效果，日历总是打开今天。
- 风险与回滚：只在视图写了这个键时才改变行为；列表视图和 ObjectView 两个生产方把这个键原样传进日历块。spec 只去掉了 `[PLANNED]` 标记、拆开了说明句，可接受的取值不变。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-calendar/src/initialDate.ts`，以及 `ObjectCalendar.tsx` 里 `currentDate` 的初始化和锚点读取。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-calendar/src/ObjectCalendar.initialDate-28102.test.tsx`，全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

席位意见：渲染器的读法正好是 spec 半声明的三种结果，日期宏复用了现有的解析器，没有第二套语法；契约复审 PASS，可以直接落地。

## 席位核对
**ACCEPT** · seat `domain:ui#3` · head `471be6e7` · 2026-10-31T06:50Z

1. **Shape:** `Fixes #28102`, draft, base `main`, 18 files, +652/−21. `initialDate.ts` (new, pure) and the seed in `ObjectCalendar.tsx` (initializer, anchor effect, `userNavigatedRef`). The `calendarBlock` in `ListView.tsx` and `generateViewSchema` in `ObjectView.tsx` forward the key nested (the seat's amendment 6538859721). `designer.ts` gains an optional member. In `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` the `[PLANNED]` marker is removed and the describe split by form (the spec half's carry-forward 6537924895). The liveness `calendar` note is plain live. Also: registry input descriptions, the regenerated manifest, its record and three reference pages, three test files, and a changeset.
2. **Premise measured:** on `main`, the renderer never read `initialDate` (the card's measurement, re-checked by the dev). The producers dropped the key before it reached the renderer, which is why the amendment added the two forwards.
3. **Gates / check-runs:** on head `471be6e7` all 65 check-runs completed, none failed, cancelled or in progress, and `mergeable_state` is clean. Dev: 113 of 115 derived gates exit 0, and 2 were NOT MEASURED (exit 3, build prerequisites: `check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`), backstopped by CI's build legs. 5 ablations went red as predicted (os-dev-report 6539576260).
4. **Accepted deviations:** none. Contract review: lane record 6539855429, `Served-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, PASS on this head, with no should-fix.
5. **Out of scope:** ③'s `ListView` first-window note (a seeded calendar fetches once more for the seeded window: correct rows, one extra request). The seat screens it out for now because it fails the business test (no user-visible defect). It will be re-raised if a measurement shows a cost. The prose in the changeset and the three reference pages matches the diff (the key's three forms and their periods). `Skills-docs: none — Metadata-protocol: none`.
6. **Landing:** `check-governed-merges --pr 28334` says NOT governed (0 of 18 paths), 673 changed lines ≤ 3000. Contract review PASS on this head. The seat readies the PR and arms auto-merge under 「按 pm-dispatch 审过的pr你可以自主落地」.
